name: hk-tiny-vo-1
text: This home... is smaller than a parking space. [short pause] Right here, in Hong Kong. About two lakh twenty thousand people live in flats like this. One old apartment... cut into tiny rooms. The typical room? About 110 square feet. A parking space is 135. And the rent... about fifty-five thousand rupees a month. So Hong Kong must be out of land, right? [pause] Not really. Only about 7% of its land has homes on it. Around 40% is protected country park. And Delhi packs more people into every square kilometre than Hong Kong does. Now a new law says a rented room must be at least 86 square feet... with a window. About 70% have already signed up. Would you live in a home smaller than a parking space? [pause] Because this one...
